text: ＊せいかく　Ｌｖ＊のとき　＊で　かえって　うんめいてきな　であいを　したようだ

structure.jp: うんめいてきな　であいを　したようだ
structure.en: seems to have had a fateful encounter

patterns.name: 〜ようだ
patterns.explanation: ようだ after a verb says 'it seems that', judging from what is known. したようだ = 'seems to have done'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: The て-form joins one action to the next, like 'and'. かえって = 'hatched, and'.

patterns.name: 〜とき
patterns.explanation: のとき after a thing means 'at the time of' or 'when it was'. Ｌｖ＊のとき = 'when it was Lv.＊'.
